stages.title: Main story
stages.why: Campaign milestones that unlock automatically; finish these first so the rest of Leonida opens up.
trophies: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

stages.title: Missable-sensitive moments
stages.why: Narrow windows: a unique hunt and story choices. Save before committing and keep the save until both trophies are secure.

stages.title: Side content and free roam
stages.why: Stranger strands, races, hobbies, robberies and property or app tasks are easiest after the campaign, when the map, money and gear are available.

stages.title: Collectibles and exploration
stages.why: Cumulative map sweeps for meditation spots, card sets, WAiNK locations, vehicle discovery and exploration.

stages.title: Challenges and 100% completion
stages.why: Stunt, shooting-range, combat, stealth and robbery challenges plus 100% completion; save the grind for after the map is open.

stages.title: Platinum
stages.why: Vice Got a Price! unlocks only after the other 54 trophies, so claim it last.

notes: Finish the main story first; the chapter and named-mission trophies are unmissable and open up the map.
Keep a manual save before major story choices and before Bret's unique-animal hunt, and do not overwrite it until those trophies are secure.
No trophy in this list is explicitly online, so everything can be planned around the single-player campaign and free roam.
After the story, sweep side content before collectibles; the pause-menu map and in-game trackers are the reliable sources for what remains.
Leave A Long Road for last and use the in-game completion checklist to clean up one category at a time.
Do not spend Marked Bills elsewhere if Dime on the Dollar is still outstanding; launder them through contacts as you earn them.
